extractions.value: Somatosensory or acoustic stimulation of the face and occiput elicited myoclonus in which the neck retracted and both shoulders elevated; no movement propagating to the upper or lower limbs was seen. This head/neck myoclonus was not provoked by tapping of the trunk, upper limbs, or lower limbs. Somatosensory stimulation of the lower limbs elicited myoclonus that rapidly stiffened the entire bilateral lower limbs; this movement was localized to both lower limbs and was not provoked by tapping of the head/neck, trunk, or upper limbs. Both the head/neck and bilateral lower-limb myoclonus tended to weaken with repeated stimulation.
